huggingFace.rule: Project admitted manifests, adapters, benchmark receipts, and source revision. Do not rehost upstream weights by default.

domains.rule: Product exposes admitted capability and runtime status; proof registry exposes source, receipts, evaluation evidence, and known bounds.

releases.whySZL: Evaluate GLM-5.3-Flash as a high-capability multimodal agent route and GLM-5.3 as the larger reasoning/coding reference. Keep provider routing and local serving interchangeable behind A11oy policy.
acceptance: Pin exact upstream model revisions and immutable metadata.
Add capability metadata without making an operational claim from a model card.
Add OpenAI-compatible/provider and self-hosted vLLM/SGLang route profiles where supported.
Run coding, tool-use, long-context, multimodal, refusal, latency, memory, and cost evaluations against current SZL baselines.
Seal benchmark inputs, model revision, runtime image, outputs, metrics, and fallback result.
Do not promote to default until all production gates pass.

releases.whySZL: Benchmark as a multimodal perception and tool-use route for document, UI, operator, and visual evidence workflows while keeping every output proposal-only behind A11oy governance.
acceptance: Pin the upstream model revision and MIT license evidence.
Add image/document/UI evaluation fixtures with checksummed inputs.
Compare multimodal reasoning and tool-use quality with the incumbent routes.
Record prompt/image provenance, output, confidence/evidence labels, latency, VRAM, and failure behavior.
Verify text-only and incumbent multimodal fallback paths.
No visual model output may bypass policy, approval, or receipt generation.

releases.whySZL: Use as a deployment and own-metal optimization candidate for the NVIDIA/KHIPU lane, focusing on throughput, memory, latency, quality retention, and reproducible runtime receipts rather than copying upstream claims.
acceptance: Pin the quantized artifact and base-model revisions.
Review NVIDIA and base-model license terms before redistribution or production use.
Add hardware preflight so unsupported devices fail closed instead of silently degrading.
Benchmark quality delta, cold start, TTFT, decode throughput, p50/p95 latency, VRAM, and cost against FP8/current routes.
Record ModelOpt/runtime versions and container digest in every benchmark receipt.
Promote only on measured benefit with a verified fallback.

required: merge the three candidates into the canonical frontier release catalog
add or update consumer adapters and route registries only where the repository owns that responsibility
add deterministic tests for capability mapping, fail-closed routing, and fallback
publish Hugging Face projection only from merged GitHub main using exact-source SHA binding
update a-11-oy.com only with admitted runtime/capability status
update a11oy.net only with proof, receipts, evaluation evidence, and known bounds
leave production defaults unchanged until production gates are explicitly satisfied
codexCompletionContract.definitionOfDone: GitHub source, Hugging Face projection, product surface, and proof registry agree on release identity, source revision, capability status, evidence class, and production disposition.
